local enabled=true
local function apply()
 if self.AssetBundle then
  local index=enabled and 2 or 0
  if self.AssetBundle.getLoopingEffectIndex()~=index then self.AssetBundle.playLoopingEffect(index)end
 end
 for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('Light')or{})do
  c.set('enabled',enabled);c.set('range',2.1);c.set('intensity',0.38);c.set('shadows',0)
  c.set('color',Color(1,0.73,0.42,1))
 end
 for _,r in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren('MeshRenderer')or{})do r.set('enabled',false)end
 for _,kind in ipairs({'MeshCollider','BoxCollider','SphereCollider','CapsuleCollider'})do
  for _,c in ipairs(self.getComponentsInChildren(kind)or{})do c.set('enabled',false)end
 end
end
function setBillboardLight(p)enabled=p.enabled==true;apply()end
function onLoad()
 self.setLock(true);self.interactable=false
 Wait.condition(apply,function()return not self.loading_custom end,30)
end

-- The shared coordinator applies visibility after host checks.
function setNeon(p)end

ContainedObjects.Name: Custom_Tile
ContainedObjects.LuaScript:
-- Universal DZ compositor: preserve mission lines while owning deployment visibility.
local function loboUniversalWrite(target,lines)
 if target.getGUID()=="f5200b" then
  local owner=getObjectFromGUID("f5200d")
  if owner and not owner.isDestroyed() then
   local ok,handled=pcall(function()return owner.call('loboUniversalSetBase',{guid=target.getGUID(),lines=lines})end)
   if ok and handled then return end
  end
 end
 target.setVectorLines(lines)
end
-- BEGIN LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2
-- Every colored centerline remains at its exact measured X/Z coordinates.
local function loboContrastDraw(target,source)
 if not target or target.isDestroyed() then return end
 local strokes={}
 for _,line in ipairs(source or {}) do
  if line.points and #line.points>1 then
   local width=math.max((tonumber(line.thickness) or .015)*1.5,.065)
   local border,core={},{}
   for k,v in pairs(line) do border[k]=v;core[k]=v end
   border.color={.006,.009,.014}
   border.thickness=width+.085
   core.thickness=width
   local c=line.color or {1,1,1}
   local r,g,b=c.r or c[1] or 1,c.g or c[2] or 1,c.b or c[3] or 1
   local maximum=math.max(r,g,b,.001)
   r,g,b=r/maximum,g/maximum,b/maximum
   if b>r*1.5 and b>g then g=math.max(g,.82);r=math.min(r,.18)
   elseif r>b*1.5 and r>=g then
    if g>.7 then g=math.max(g,.95);b=math.min(b,.12)
    else g=math.max(g,.55);b=math.min(b,.16) end
   end
   core.color={r,g,b}
   core.points={}
   for _,p in ipairs(line.points) do
    local world=target.positionToWorld(Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3]))
    world.y=world.y+.004
    local q=target.positionToLocal(world)
    core.points[#core.points+1]={q.x,q.y,q.z}
   end
   strokes[#strokes+1]=border
   strokes[#strokes+1]=core
  end
 end
 loboUniversalWrite(target,strokes)
end
-- END LOBO CONTRAST DEPLOYMENT LINES V2



-- Immediate static lock: preserve scenery before physics can resolve stacked colliders.
local originalOnLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 self.setLock(true)
 if originalOnLoad then originalOnLoad(saved) end
end

-- Mission markings retained from the map bag loader.
local LOBO_MISSION_LINES=JSON.decode("[]")
local loboSurfaceOnLoad=onLoad
function onLoad(saved)
 if loboSurfaceOnLoad then loboSurfaceOnLoad(saved) end
 Wait.frames(function()
  local localLines={}
  local scale=self.getScale()
  local lineScale=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),0.000001)
  for _,line in ipairs(LOBO_MISSION_LINES) do
   local points={}
   for _,point in ipairs(line.points) do
    local p=self.positionToLocal(point)
    points[#points+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   end
   localLines[#localLines+1]={points=points,color=line.color,thickness=line.thickness/lineScale}
  end
  loboContrastDraw(self, localLines)
 end,2)
end

local function universalCommit()
 local mat=universalMat();if not mat or self.isDestroyed() then return end

local function universalIsBoundary(mat,line)
 local points=line.points or{};if #points<2 then return false end
 -- Only replace the original DZ boundary; mission quadrants and exclusion lines survive.
 for side=1,2 do
  local yes=true
  for _,p in ipairs(points)do
   local v=mat.positionToWorld(Vector(p.x or p[1],p.y or p[2],p.z or p[3]))
   local distance
   if universalConfig.shape=='corner' then
    local sign=side==1 and 1 or -1
    distance=math.sqrt((v.x-sign*24)^2+(v.z-sign*24)^2)-universalConfig.depth
   else distance=v.x-(side==1 and -1 or 1)*(24-universalConfig.depth)end
   if math.abs(distance)>.045 then yes=false;break end
  end
  if yes then return true end
 end

end
function loboUniversalSetBase(p)

local function universalBuild()
 universalGeneration=universalGeneration+1;local generation=universalGeneration
 local mat=universalMat();if not mat then return end
 universalGuides={};universalCommit()
 local jobs={}
 for _,offset in ipairs({0,4,8})do if universalEnabled[offset]then
  for side=1,2 do jobs[#jobs+1]={offset=offset,side=side,points={},top={}}end
 end end
 if #jobs==0 then return end
 local jobIndex,sample=1,0;local scale=mat.getScale();local width=math.max(math.abs(scale.x),math.abs(scale.z),.000001)
 local strokes={}
 local function step()
  if generation~=universalGeneration or self.isDestroyed() or not universalMat()then return end
  for work=1,8 do
   local job=jobs[jobIndex]
   if not job then universalGuides=strokes;universalCommit();return end
   local depth=universalConfig.depth+job.offset;local x,z
   if universalConfig.shape=='corner' then
    local sign=job.side==1 and 1 or -1;local angle=sample*math.pi/192
    x=sign*(24-depth*math.cos(angle));z=sign*(24-depth*math.sin(angle))
   else x=(job.side==1 and -1 or 1)*(24-depth);z=-24+sample*.5 end
   local y=universalConfig.surface+.028
   if Physics and Physics.cast then
    local ok,hits=pcall(function()return Physics.cast({origin={x,40,z},direction={0,-1,0},type=1,max_distance=65})end)
    if ok then for _,hit in ipairs(hits or{})do
     local o=hit.hit_object
     if o and hit.point and o.hasTag(universalConfig.tag) and not o.hasTag('mission') and not o.hasTag('LoboBackgroundController') and not o.hasTag('controller') then y=math.max(y,hit.point.y+.028)end
    end end
   end
   local p=mat.positionToLocal(Vector(x,y,z));job.points[#job.points+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   p=mat.positionToLocal(Vector(x,y+.003,z));job.top[#job.top+1]={p.x,p.y,p.z}
   sample=sample+1
   if sample>96 then
    strokes[#strokes+1]={points=job.points,color={.01,.015,.02},thickness=.18/width}
    local c=job.side==1 and {.15,.78,1} or {1,.58,.16}
    if job.offset==4 then c=job.side==1 and {.3,1,.65} or {1,.84,.2}

   end
  end

 end

end
